text:
Nina (sales): Avalon Bio wants a 2-week POC for their Avalon-30B-ft variant. Need catalog onboarding, perf estimates, and BYOK/TLS details.
Ethan (SE): quick qs: artifact type? tokenizer changes? expected seq lengths and traffic?
Kai (Avalon Bio): artifact = sharded safetensors (3 shards). tokenizer = sentencepiece + 2 custom tokens. main workloads: 512-2k, occasional 10k. prefer VPC + BYOK.
Harper (solutions): proposed triage: 1) tokenization test 2) shard-load stress 3) 2k + 10k KV profiling 4) staging perf run for p95 token latency at 100/300 rps.
Ethan (SE): upload command for staging:
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/models/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" \
  -F "artifact=@avalon_30b.tar.gz" \
  -F "samples=@samples.zip"
```
Vik (security): security intake: vendor questionnaire + KMS ARN for BYOK + data residency. PHI flagged requests must be private-only.
UploadBot: scheduled compat-run #cr-5521 on 2026-01-12T04:00:00Z (staging). est 50m.
Harper (solutions): I'll draft hosted vs dedicated cost scenarios. Owners: artifact + samples (Kai), compat tests (Ethan), pricing (Harper), security intake (Vik). ETA: samples today -> tests tomorrow.
Kai (Avalon Bio): uploading samples now, will include raw->token examples and PHI labels. Thanks all.
